description: The Mohler dataset consists of short answers from computer science students at a Texas university, graded on a 0–5 scale by two raters; in this work, only data where both raters agreed on the grade is used.

paper: State-of-the-art automated essay scoring: Competition, results, and future directions from a United States demonstration
description: The ASAP dataset consists of approximately 13,000 student essays from grades 7–10 on 8 distinct essay prompts, scored for overall and attribute-specific writing quality.

ASAP 2.0 is an enhanced automated essay scoring dataset containing essays from diverse student populations with annotations for multiple essay attributes, designed to advance fair and reliable automated writing assessment

The ELLIPSE dataset consists of 10,000+ English learner essays graded on six linguistic and writing quality dimensions for automated scoring research, only data where both raters agreed on the grade is used.

PT_ASAG_2018 is a dataset of real student and teacher answers from Brazil for research in Portuguese Automatic Short Answer Grading (ASAG), containing questions, concepts, graded student answers, and teacher reference answers.
